title: health-check --all JSON batch
description: Fleet payload of `ssh-cli health-check --all` / `--hosts` (`event: "health-check-batch"`). Requires `batch_run_id`, which the doctor's embedded probe does not carry.

batch_run_id.description: UUID v7 (hyphenated) correlating this multi-host run

agent_shape.description: Present only when a global shaping flag (--select, --filter, --limit, --sort, --dedupe-by, --count-only, --truncate-content or --max-output-bytes) reduced this envelope. It reports what the reduction did to the `results` array.

input_count.description: items in the array before shaping

content_truncated.description: true when --truncate-content shortened at least one string

output_truncated.description: true when --max-output-bytes dropped items to fit the byte budget

count.description: Present only with --count-only, which replaces the `results` array by the number of items left after the other shaping flags

latency_ms.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds; a host whose connection failed reports 0 together with status `error`
